map.输入工作年限与月工资，依据《劳动合同法》分别计算 N、N+1、2N 三种情形下的: Enter years of service and monthly wage, and compute severance under the Labour Contract Law for the three cases N, N+1 and 2N, covering payout estimates for negotiated termination, unlawful termination and other separation scenarios.
map.填写「当地社平工资3倍（元/月）」。: Fill in '3 times local average wage (CNY/month)'.
map.填写「是否提前30天通知」。: Fill in 'whether 30 days advance notice was given'.
map.解除/终止劳动合同时，选择 N、N+1 或 2N 类型测算应付总额。: When rescinding or terminating a labour contract, choose the N, N+1 or 2N type and estimate the total payable.
map.N 按工作年限计算，满半年不满 1 年按 1 年、不满半年按 0.5 年。: N is counted by years of service: at least half a year but under 1 year counts as 1 year, under half a year counts as 0.5 year.
map.高薪者基数与年限双封顶，并提示个税免征额。: High earners are capped on both base and years, and the personal tax exemption is flagged.
map.工作 5.5 年、月薪 1 万、N: 5.5 years of service, monthly salary 10,000, N
map.：5.5 年 → 满 5 年 + 0.5 年进位为 6 个月，N = 6；经济补: : 5.5 years -> 5 full years plus 0.5 year rounded up to 6 months, N = 6; severance = 10000 × 6 = 60,000 CNY.
map.：同条件违法解除：赔偿金 = 10000 × 6 × 2 = 120,000 元: : unlawful termination under the same conditions: compensation = 10000 × 6 × 2 = 120,000 CNY (N is not paid separately).
map.工作年限怎么算？: How are years of service counted?
map.按本单位连续工作年限，六个月以上不满一年的按一年，不满六个月的支付半个月工资。: By continuous years of service with the unit: at least six months but under one year counts as one year, and under six months pays half a month's wage.
map.当地上年职工平均工资 3 倍以内免征；超出部分不并入当年综合所得，单独适用综合所: Within 3 times the local average wage of the previous year it is exempt; the excess is not pooled into that year's comprehensive income and is taxed separately under the comprehensive income rate table.
